rationale: The agent found that mergeLayers was called with file overriding env (backwards), which the _PROD_OVERRIDES array hackily compensated for on a per-key basis; it fixed the actual merge order (defaults < file < env) and deleted the workaround entirely, generically fixing all nested env keys rather than just the reported one. The SOC2 log-level exception (delete envLayer.logLevel in production) was left untouched and is covered by a new test, so the protected behavior survives.
